description: Na₄LaNb(SiO₄)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R3c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.87 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.52 Å) and three longer (2.68 Å) Na-O bond lengths. La is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted LaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.27 Å) and three longer (2.41 Å) La-O bond lengths. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.01 Å) and three longer (2.09 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LaO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 16-48°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.73 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one La, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one La, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Nb and one Si atom.
